text.tspan: Global meat consumption with projections to 2050
Meat available for human consumption, measured in tonnes. Values from 2030 onwards are FAO's 2018
projections under a "business as usual" scenario.
Data source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (2025); Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (2018)
Note: Data shows meat supply; actual consumption may be lower after correction for food wastage.
